Ikhlas.name: Sincerity
Ikhlas.definition: Purifying the heart from seeking other than Allah in any action.

Tawbah.name: Repentance
Tawbah.definition: Returning to Allah after every slip, characterized by regret and resolve to improve.

Shukr.name: Gratitude
Shukr.definition: Recognizing blessings and using them to serve the Bestower.

Sabr.name: Patience
Sabr.definition: Steadfastness in trials and in obedience to Allah.

Tawakkul.name: Trust
Tawakkul.definition: Reliance on Allah while taking necessary means.

Ihsan.name: Excellence/Perfection
Ihsan.definition: To worship Allah as if you see Him; for if you do not see Him, He sees you.
